text: dsh-okf 是面向 DSH 的 Open Knowledge Format 插件，可把 Markdown 概念文档作为知识包管理。它注册初始化、校验、搜索、读取、写入和可视化工具，并提供状态、图谱和浏览器视图接口；适合希望以带 YAML 元数据和链接的文档维护知识图谱的用户。图谱页面从 jsDelivr 加载 Cytoscape.js 与 marked；不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-okf manages Open Knowledge Format bundles of linked Markdown concepts. DSH tools initialize, validate, search, read, write, and visualize bundles; web routes expose status, graph data, and a browser view. The graph page loads Cytoscape.js and marked from jsDelivr. No API key is required.
想把带链接的 Markdown 知识文档整理成能检查的概念图谱。
DSH 能不能帮我按关键词、类型或标签搜索知识库里的概念？
I want to browse relationships between concepts in my Markdown knowledge base as an interactive graph.
dsh-okf 的「知识包校验」功能：检查 OKF 文档的 frontmatter、链接与概念状态，并返回错误、警告和统计。通过 DSH 的校验工具调用，可选择严格模式。
dsh-okf 的「知识图谱浏览」功能：把概念及其链接生成交互式图谱，并提供搜索、筛选和详情视图。通过 DSH Web Server 的 /api/okf/view 页面打开，也可由可视化工具导出 HTML。

dsh-okf README · DSH OKF Plugin (`dsh-okf`)：A production-ready [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin implementing the **[Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2)](https://okf.md/spec/)** standard.

Instead of unstructured chunks and probabilistic embeddings that cause agent hallucinations, OKF models complex systems as a **verifiable, deterministic knowledge graph of Markdown documents with strict YAML frontmatter, backlinks, freshness tracking, and audit trails**.

---

dsh-okf README · Features：- **6 DSH Agent Tools**:
  - `okf_init`: Initialize a standards-compliant OKF v0.2 bundle (`index.md`, `log.md`, starter concepts).
  - `okf_validate`: Deterministic linter checking frontmatter, required `type`, broken links, orphan concepts, and stale status.
  - `okf_search`: Search concepts by keyword, type, tag, or verification status.
  - `okf_concept_read`: Read concept frontmatter, markdown body, and computed incoming backlinks.
  - `okf_concept_write`: Create or update concept files with frontmatter validation and automatic audit logging in `log.md`.
  - `okf_visualize`: Export interactive force-directed HTML graph (`viz.html`) powered by Cytoscape.js.

dsh-okf README · Features：- **Interactive Web UI & REST API**:
  - `GET /api/okf/view`: Full-screen browser visualizer with search, category filtering, layout switching, and inspector sidebar.
  - `GET /api/okf/graph`: Cytoscape-compatible JSON graph (nodes, edges, backlinks, metadata).
  - `GET /api/okf/status`: Health and conformance stats for the active workspace.

dsh-okf README · Features：- **DSH System Prompt & Skill Integration**:
  - Bundled DSH skill under `skills/okf/SKILL.md`.
  - Injects runtime guidance into DSH agent context so the agent automatically uses OKF practices.

dsh-okf README · Method 1: CLI Install (Recommended)：Run the `dsh plugin add` command to install directly from GitHub into your profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:TorRient/dsh-okf
```

This will automatically:
- Download and link `dsh-okf` into your profile's `node_modules/`.
- Register `dsh-okf` into your active profile bundles (`dsh.profile.bundles`).
- Mount the 6 OKF agent tools, web visualizer routes, and the bundled OKF agent skill.

dsh-okf README · Method 2: Local Link (For Development)：1. Symlink or link the package to your DSH profile (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/`):
```bash
ln -s /path/to/dsh-okf ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-okf
```

2. Register the bundle in your DSH profile manifest (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`):

dsh-okf README · OKF Bundle Structure：```text
my-knowledge-base/
├── index.md           # Bundle root manifest & table of contents
├── log.md             # Append-only revision changelog
└── concepts/          # Domain, Architecture, API, and Schema concepts

dsh-okf README · Concept Frontmatter Example：```markdown
---
type: Architecture
title: Payment Gateway
description: "Processes credit card transactions and settlements."
status: verified
stale_after: "2026-12-31"
tags:
  - payments
  - billing
sources:
  - "https://internal.wiki/pay-v2"
---
